sentences.en: After that night they became infamous in the entire city.
sentences.zh: 那一夜之后，他们在整个城市臭名昭著。

sentences.en: That news website is infamous for its ragebait headlines.
sentences.zh: 这个新闻网站以发布激怒读者的标题而臭名昭著。

sentences.en: Hitler was one of the most infamous dictators.
sentences.zh: 希特勒是臭名昭著的独裁者之一。

senses.zh: 声名狼藉的；无耻的；邪恶的
